Paragraph: "Seetha used to cling to me with similar affection; how can I endure living without her gentle touch?"
Situation/Problem_Faced: Seeing creepers on trees triggers tactile memories of Seetha's physical affection and closeness.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama voices his deep longing for physical and emotional affection.
Outcome/Resolution: He expresses the physical ache of missing his spouse.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Sparsha-Smriti (Memory of physical touch and affectionate embrace of a loved one)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Touch memory (Sparsha) highlights the profound human dimension of divine incarnation experiencing attachment.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Skin hunger and tactile grief: yearning for the physical presence and comforting touch of a missing partner.
